# Replay fixture

`territory.replay` is Boxcars' `assets/replays/good/6796.replay`, pinned to
Boxcars commit `6f843778a116224d0d1aeedf158ccf58d265318c` and obtained through
go-rocket commit `78d49c33f9c453e52e2679285cb284d6babd06d1`.

Source: https://github.com/nickbabcock/boxcars

SHA-256: `3816239ba482dc3caf0c33c74583be6b57f30e1a9881ab2b0b5ff4c3cd71ac47`

The 26 KB replay has 248 frames (engine/licensee/network 868/32/10). It covers
real metadata, network events, and car/ball position samples without downloading
fixtures during tests. Redistribution terms are in `LICENSE.txt`.
